extraction.notes: Amounts in thousands. FFO, Core FFO and Core AFFO totals each foot to the printed subtotals (10,129; 11,253; 13,084). Diluted shares of 101,611 (page 8, in thousands) reproduces reported per-share figures ($0.10 FFO, $0.11 Core FFO, $0.13 Core AFFO). Footnote 1 lists 9,653 OP units plus 92,934 basic shares, which would sum above 101,611; the reported per-share figures tie to 101,611, so that figure was used. Classification judgments: 'Amortization of derivative premium' was mapped to debt_cost_amortization (could be read as derivative); 'Land and other impairments' mapped to re_impairment; 'Amortization of market lease intangibles' and 'Amortization of lease inducements' mapped to other. Several lines are zero in the current quarter and are kept for completeness. AFFO deducts building improvements and TI/LC, so recurring capex disclosure is null.
